# QuickView v6.46.0.6 Pre-release Notes

> **Changelog covering updates from v6.37.0.0 to v6.46.0.6: Introduction of In-Process AI Neural Super-Resolution Engine, AMD FSR 1.0 Integration, Objective RAW Color Decoding, and the Overhaul of the GeekWidgets UI Architecture.**

---

## Highlights

### 1. QVX 2.0 In-Process AI Neural Super-Resolution (#239)
QuickView introduces **QVX (QuickView eXtension) 2.0**, integrating the Tencent NCNN Vulkan neural network compute pipeline directly into the host process:
- **Direct GPU Memory Pipeline (0 Disk I/O)**: Eliminates external process spawning and temporary disk caching. Image frames flow seamlessly between Direct3D 11 Staging and Vulkan GPU memory via zero-copy in-memory streams (#239).
- **Omni-Lifecycle Auto-Trigger System**:
  - **Small Image Launch**: Automatically triggers debounced super-resolution when images are initially loaded at >100% scale (#239).
  - **Navigation**: Next/Previous page switches automatically trigger super-resolution once the base frame is ready (#239).
  - **Fullscreen & Maximization**: Viewport enlargement via `F11` or `Enter` automatically triggers resolution enhancement (#239).
  - **Window Resize**: Automatically activates super-resolution upon mouse release after dragging window borders (#239).
  - **Smooth Zooming**: Seamlessly triggers upscale as soon as the mouse wheel animation stabilizes (#239).
  - **View Mode Shortcuts**: Switching between Actual Size (`1`), Fit to Window (`2`), and Fill Window (`3`) automatically reconstructs the image (#239).
- **Full Animation Sequence Upscaling**: Multi-threaded pipeline upscaling for GIF, APNG, WebP, and AVIF animated formats, resuming high-definition playback seamlessly upon completion (#239).
- **Halo Seam-Elimination Matrix & VRAM Protection**: Seamless tile chunking algorithm eliminates grid artifacts across large upscaled images. Automatic interception for images exceeding 16 megapixels prevents GPU out-of-memory (OOM) errors, accompanied by millisecond-latency Cancellation Token responsiveness (#239).
- **Self-Healing Portable Architecture & Graceful Fallback**: Self-heals relative plugin paths when the application folder is relocated across different drives or machines. Automatically degrades cleanly when plugins are not installed while offering one-click download and updates in the Settings Panel (#239).

---

### 2. AMD FidelityFX Super Resolution 1.0 (FSR 1.0) Real-Time Spatial Upscaling (#239)
- Integrated AMD FSR 1.0 algorithms (**Edge-Adaptive Spatial Upsampling - EASU** and **Robust Contrast-Adaptive Sharpening - RCAS**) into the Direct3D 11 Compute Shader pipeline (#239).
- Delivers near-native sharpness and texture reconstruction for real-time scaling with minimal GPU compute overhead (#239).

---

### 3. RAW Adaptive Color Space & Objective Rendering (#241)
- **Direct Gamut Mapping**: Re-architected the RAW decoding pipeline to extract camera native primaries and matrices, transforming them directly into Direct2D scRGB linear space (#241).
- **High Dynamic Range (HDR) Integration**: Seamlessly integrates Windows Advanced Color (HDR) with Color Management System (CMS) dynamic tone mapping (piecewise Spline curves and ITU-R BT.2390 EETF), preserving highlight roll-off and true color fidelity (#241).

---

### 4. GeekWidgets Atomic UI Architecture & Interaction Redesign (#144, #243, #246)
- **Segmented Discrete Slider**: Redesigned UI scale control supporting discrete step quantization (100% - 300%) and in-place capsule text input for tablet and touch devices (#144, #243).
- **Pill-Shaped High-Definition OSD**: Redesigned HUD status overlay featuring smooth translucent gradients, dynamic status indicators, and micro-interactions (#239).
- **Full Keyboard Navigation**: Comprehensive keyboard control across Settings and overlay panels via Tab, Arrow keys, Enter, and Esc (#144).
- **Desktop Focus Handover Protocol**: Automatically restores keyboard and window focus to the previously active application upon exiting QuickView (#246).

---

## Performance & Architecture

- **Instant Loading for Massive Directories**: Overhauled `FileNavigator` directory scanning with non-blocking asynchronous indexing, achieving instant startup and smooth navigation in folders containing tens of thousands of images (#241).
- **Vector EMF / WMF Rendering Enhancements**: Added full support for Windows Metafile (EMF/WMF) transparency alpha blending and high-quality anti-aliased rasterization (#144).
- **Clipboard Delayed Rendering Optimization**: Dual-pipeline support for RAW, transparent PNG, and DIB delayed rendering with high-performance instant copying (#240).
- **Zero-Allocation Hot Paths & Binary Reduction**: Applied Data-Oriented Design (DOD) principles to eliminate heap allocations and virtual calls in rendering and decoding loops, maintaining a compact binary footprint.


---

## Bug Fixes & Hardening

- **[Fix]** Resolved DirectComposition surface tearing and flickering during window edge resizing (#144).
- **[Fix]** Fixed splitter dragging sensitivity and configuration save synchronization in Compare Mode (#239).
- **[Fix]** Fixed infinite confirmation prompt loop when discarding changes upon exiting Crop Mode.
- **[Fix]** Resolved interaction deadlock between the filmstrip gallery hotspot and the info panel (#144).
- **[Fix]** Prevented smooth zoom and double-click events from unintentionally penetrating to underlying edge navigation zones (#144).
- **[Fix]** Standardized English labels to Chicago Title Case across Settings overlays (#144).
- **[CI/CD]** Harmonized LLVM and Clang-cl toolchains in GitHub Actions, establishing automated native packaging and standalone plugin distribution for both x64 (AMD64) and ARM64 architectures (#239).

---

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/justnullname/QuickView/compare/v6.37.0.0...v6.46.0.6
